Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through an intersection in Houston, Texas, while turning left when the front of Driver 2's vehicle
struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with that angle and force.
Driver 1 reported neck and back pain, and the injuries described fit the type of impact observed at the scene.
Responding officers and the drivers confirmed that Passenger was seated in the fornt passenger position at the time
of the collision. Scene photographs show some of the damage and positions of the vehicles, but no independent
witnesses were located, and no one came forward to describe the sequence of events. Officers found no indication of
prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle, and records checked at the scene show Driver 1 is the named driver on the policy
covering that vehicle. Both drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles were removed from the roadway by tow.
